layout_defects_found.details: Repeated storage redb headings such as Canonical records, Required redb keys, Cross-surface receipt record, Scope split, projection freshness, account pressure, artifacts index, worktree/lane lifecycle, and Naming and migration rules created ambiguous packet anchors.
Runtime artifact and projection-state storage content before Canonical terminal persistence decomposition had no unique local heading.
The owner-first reconciliation bullet and the following Canonical records heading were joined on one line.
Overlapping runtime scheduler and recovery addenda reused child heading names for scheduler pass, score tuple, wakeup triggers, remediation lineage, attempt identity, and acceptance carry-through.
Three adjacent HITL recovery action addenda covered the same recovery-action semantics with overlapping owner headings.

repairs_applied.repair: Renamed repeated storage redb headings with explicit baseline, runtime/storage, ownership split, owner reconciliation, and terminal/storage scopes; fixed the malformed heading boundary.
Created a unique owner heading for runtime artifact and projection-state storage content that previously lived in an untitled preamble.
